Vehicle was struck on the front driver-side quarter while the other car was turning left across its path. The damage visible on the
front bumper cover, driver-side headlamp assembly, and fender is consistent with that type of impact, and the pattern of contact
points lines up with the account given. No prior damage to this vehicle is known, and the paperwork reviewed shows no repeated
charges for the same parts or labor. Proposed repairs call for replacing the bumper cover, headlamp, and fender, plus refinishing
and a radiator support check. The labor hours assigned to each operation fit the extent of the damage, and the plan is reasonable
for a vehicle in this condition.
